notes: Discovered via homepage mega menu (Holidays nav), the /shop/holiday-decor/ landing hub, the shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz sitemap, and the site's own internal search/taxonomy API (Bloomreach/Constructor.io, ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/*, key found embedded in PLP page JSON as constructorKey) which is the same-origin data source that renders each PLP's product grid and 'N Items' header. Verified the API count matches the rendered header exactly on 2 sample pages (Christmas Ornaments & Tree Toppers: 58 Items; Holiday Decor: 191 Items) before relying on it for the rest. Direct HTTP fetches to www.potterybarn.com (curl_cffi, Chrome impersonation) worked initially (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow) but got rate-limited to 403 after several requests; browser (Claude-in-Chrome) fetches were used for spot checks. As of visit date (Sept 2026, off-season for Christmas), the visible top nav under Holidays only surfaces Halloween and Thanksgiving live, with Christmas collapsed under a 'Sneak Peek' link -- the sitemap + taxonomy API were used to recover the full Christmas subcategory set that the seasonal nav does not currently surface. Also checked /shop/gifts/ (found Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day Gifts as real PLPs) and /shop/new/ (found Easter as a real PLP; also found several trend/style/franchise pages there that were excluded, see below). Excluded as marketing/navigation/non-category, not extracted: 'All Holidays' (all-holidays-shop, 1642 items -- site-wide Shop-All aggregate across every holiday); Halloween/Thanksgiving/Holiday 'Feature - Products' widgets (counts of 1-2); 'Thanksgiving Product Scroller - *' widgets (4 variants, counts 2-5); 'Our Favorite Holiday Mantels', 'Our Favorite Holiday Front Doors', 'Our Favorite Christmas Trees', 'Our Favorite Ways to Trim the Tree', 'Our Favorite Ways to Set the Thanksgiving Table' (incl. a '-m' mobile-duplicate variant) -- inspiration/editorial pages; 'Christmas By Style - Chateau/Coastal/Winter White' and 'Christmas in the Country' -- curated look/style pages, not product-type categories; 'Timeless Traditions' and 'Thanksgiving Headquarters' / 'Christmas Headquarters' / 'Holiday Concierge' (counts of 1-2) -- hub/landing/service pages; 'Stewart Plaid' -- designer-name collection; 'Monique Lhuillier Holiday Collection', 'National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation', 'The Nightmare Before Christmas' -- brand/franchise-licensed tie-in collections, not generic seasonal categories; 'Holiday Glow', 'Holiday Whimsy', 'Holiday Quilts' (trend-* pages under /shop/new/) -- trend/style pages, not holiday-specific; 'holiday-party-entertaining-old' -- legacy/deprecated duplicate not present in the sitemap; 'holiday-all-thanksgiving-decor1' -- near-duplicate slug of the real Thanksgiving Shop with a much smaller count, treated as a stale/duplicate group. No Rule-0 room-word exclusions were needed. Kept the broad root shop pages (Christmas Decor, Holiday Decor, The Halloween Shop, The Thanksgiving Shop, etc.) as their own rows even though they numerically overlap with the more specific sibling sub-categories, since the site's taxonomy does not present them as a strict parent with these as children (no nesting relation returned by the taxonomy API; each queried group came back with 0 children) -- this is normal broad-vs-narrow PLP overlap, not an exact duplicate, so per the overlap rule (identical count+facets required) nothing was collapsed.
